resumen.nota: Sentences generated by rules from the run's data; each one points to its figure.
fig.especies: Bots per species ({n#the largest|the {n} largest}), stacked. Dashed lines mark the summary's findings.
fig.especiesOtras: Bots per species ({n#the largest|the {n} largest} and "others"), stacked. Dashed lines mark the summary's findings.
grupo.sinDatos: No data for this group in the run.
banda: The shaded band spans the minimum to the maximum of the samples each point merges.
fig.total: Total living bots, vegetables and non-vegetables.
fig.adn: Mean DNA length, in instructions per bot.
fig.nacimientos: Births and deaths per sample (every {intervalo} {intervalo#cycle|cycles}), adding up all species.
fig.disparos: Shots by type per sample (every {intervalo} {intervalo#cycle|cycles}), stacked.
fig.histogramas: Distributions at cycle {ciclo} (one per panel, with the number of bots counted).
gen.resumen: {n} {n#species|species}: {raices} seeded or arrived from outside and {hijas} that arose during the run.
fig.genealogia: Species tree: each bar runs from the cycle the species appeared to the last one it had bots; × marks an extinction.
gen.fotosNota: Gene-by-gene comparison between the first snapshot of each species' dominant DNA and the last one.
pie.datos: Data embedded in this file: {puntos} {puntos#point|points} × {series} {series#series|series}, {eventos} {eventos#event|events} and the species tree.
hallazgo.dominio: {especie} made up more than {umbral} % of the population between cycles {desde} and {hasta} (up to {max} %).
hallazgo.colapso: The non-vegetable population fell {caida} % between cycles {desde} and {hasta}: from {de} to {a} {a#bot|bots}.
hallazgo.extincion: {especie} went extinct at cycle {ciclo}; its peak was {pico} {pico#bot|bots} at cycle {cicloPico}.
hallazgo.extincion.retorno: {especie} disappeared at cycle {ciclo} and came back at cycle {vuelve}; its peak was {pico} {pico#bot|bots}.
hallazgo.adn.crecimiento: DNA length in non-vegetable species grew {cambio} % (from {de} to {a} instructions on average, comparing each species with itself).
hallazgo.adn.reduccion: DNA length in non-vegetable species fell {cambio} % (from {de} to {a} instructions on average, comparing each species with itself).
evento.extincionVegetal: {especie} ran out of bots (vegetable: it is replenished)
evento.extincionVuelve: {especie} ran out of bots and came back later
hallazgo.extincion.intermitente: {especie} disappeared and came back {veces} {veces#time|times} between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
hallazgo.extincion.intermitenteFin: {especie} disappeared and came back {veces} {veces#time|times} from cycle {desde} on, and went extinct at cycle {hasta}.
hallazgo.resto.dominio: Also, {n} more {n#period|periods} of dominance between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
hallazgo.resto.colapso: Also, {n} more population {n#drop|drops} between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
hallazgo.resto.extincion: Also, {n} more species {n#disappearance|disappearances} between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
hallazgo.resto.adn: Also, {n} more DNA {n#change|changes} between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
hallazgo.sustitucion: {otra} displaced {especie} between cycles {desde} and {hasta} (they crossed at cycle {ciclo}): {especie} went from {antes} % to {despues} % of the non-vegetables and {otra}, from {antesOtra} % to {despuesOtra} %.
hallazgo.oscilacion: {especie} oscillated between cycles {desde} and {hasta}: {periodos} full {periodos#cycle|cycles} of about {periodo} simulation cycles, {amplitud} {amplitud#bot|bots} from peak to trough ({pct} % of its mean population).
hallazgo.oscilacion.total: The non-vegetable population oscillated between cycles {desde} and {hasta}: {periodos} full {periodos#cycle|cycles} of about {periodo} simulation cycles, {amplitud} {amplitud#bot|bots} from peak to trough ({pct} % of its mean).
hallazgo.oscilacion.grupo: {n} {n#species|species} oscillated together between cycles {desde} and {hasta}, with a period of about {periodo} cycles: {ejemplos}.
hallazgo.oscilacion.grupoTotal: The non-vegetable population oscillated between cycles {desde} and {hasta} with a period of about {periodo} cycles, and {ejemplos} {n#oscillated|oscillated} with it.
hallazgo.resto.sustitucion: Also, {n} more species {n#replacement|replacements} between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
hallazgo.resto.oscilacion: Also, {n} more population {n#oscillation|oscillations} between cycles {desde} and {hasta}.
cmp.nDiferencias: {n} {n#difference|differences} at start or during the run (options are compared by their effective value: base plus changes).
cmp.sinDiferencias: Both runs have the same configuration.
cmp.mismoMundo: Seeds {a} and {b} give the same world: the engine uses only 16 bits of the state derived from the seed, so both runs start the same.
fig.cmpEspecies: {lado}: bots per species ({n#the largest|the {n} largest}), stacked.
fig.cmpEspeciesOtras: {lado}: bots per species ({n#the largest|the {n} largest} and "others"), stacked.
fig.cmp: {metrica}: A as a solid line and B as a dashed line.
resumen.notaCmp: Sentences generated by rules from each run's data; each one points to its figure.
cmp.finalesNota: Last point of each run's history (cycle {a} in A and {b} in B). The difference is B − A.
pie.cmp: Data embedded in this file: {series} {series#series|series} from both runs, their configurations and their differences.
rep.parcial: {hechas} of {n} replicates finished: the results are partial.
rep.frase: {metrica} at the end: {media} ± {desvio} on average (between {min} and {max} over {n} {n#replicate|replicates}).
resumen.notaRep: Sentences generated by rules from the last sample of each replicate (mean ± standard deviation); each one points to its figure.
rep.caliente: Each replicate repeats {n} {n#live change|live changes} from the source run at the same cycle.
rep.sinCaliente: The source run had no live changes.
rep.c19: While choosing the seeds, {n#{n} seed that repeated an already used world was|{n} seeds that repeated an already used world were} skipped: the engine tells 65,536 worlds apart by seed, and two replicates of the same world would silently shrink the band and the deviation.
rep.bandasNota: At each cycle, the line is the mean of the replicates and the band goes from the 10th to the 90th percentile.
rep.tablaNota: Last sample of each replicate (cycle {ciclo}), unmerged; sample standard deviation.
pie.rep: Data embedded in this file: {series} aggregated {series#series|series}, the final table and the {n} {n#seed|seeds}.
objeto.forma: Random obstacle of {ancho} % × {alto} % of the field
objeto.formas: 10 random obstacles of {ancho} % × {alto} % of the field
torneo.fmt.cup: World cup: groups of 4 and a bracket
torneo.fmt.cupTercero: World cup: groups of 4, a bracket and a third-place match
torneo.fmt.koth: king of the hill, {k} per fight, retires after {n} wins in a row
torneo.fmt.kothSinFin: endless king of the hill, {k} per fight
torneo.fig.eloCap: Elo of {n} {n#entrant|entrants} (the best final Elo, of {total}) after each match played. Everyone starts at 1500.
torneo.como.elo: had the best Elo at the fight cap
torneo.como.dry: topped the table when no fresh challenger was left
torneo.hallazgo.tope: {pct}% of the rounds ({n} of {rondas}) were decided by the cycle cap.
torneo.hallazgo.nulos: {n} {n#match was void|matches were void} (a void match is played again).
torneo.resumenNota: Sentences written by rules from the standings and the matches.
torneo.desempate.swiss: Points (win 1, bye 1); ties broken by Buchholz, Elo and rounds won by extinction. By cap: share of the rounds won that the cycle cap decided.
torneo.desempate.cup: How far each one went in the cup, then wins and Elo.
torneo.desempate.ladder: The ladder order; those not placed yet, last.
torneo.desempate.rr: Wins, then Elo and fewer matches played.
torneo.desempate.elo: Elo (1500 at the start; in a fight of N, the winner beats each of the others), then wins.
torneo.suizoSinSorteo: The round 1 order is drawn when the first match starts.
torneo.copaTamano: A World cup needs 8, 16 or 32 entrants (it has {n}).
torneo.copaSinSorteo: The groups have not been drawn yet.
torneo.rey: On the hill: {nombre}, with {n} {n#win|wins} in a row.
torneo.sinRey: The hill has no king right now.
torneo.sinPartidos: No match has been played yet.
torneo.partidosNota: Every match can be replayed with its seed: the same rules, the same entrants with their frozen DNA and the same seeding order give the same result.
torneo.reglas.clasica: World: the rules of the options panel of the classic interface (a migrated or imported tournament).
pie.torneo: Data embedded in this file: the season with its {partidos} {partidos#match|matches}, the standings and the Elo of {series} {series#entrant|entrants} after each match (in the CSV, the “ciclo” column is the match number and “especie” the bot).
barrido.parcial: {hechas} of {total} runs finished: the results are partial.
barrido.frase: {metrica} at the end: the highest mean ({mAlto}) comes with {parametro} = {alto} and the lowest ({mBajo}) with {parametro} = {bajo}.
barrido.notaResumen: Means of the final value over the finished seeds of each value; check the p10–p90 band before drawing conclusions.
barrido.caliente: Each run repeats at the same cycle {n} live {n#change|changes} of the source run.
barrido.curvasNota: For each value of {parametro}, the line is the mean final value over the seeds and the band spans the 10th to 90th percentile.
barrido.fig: {metrica} at the end by {parametro}: mean of {n} {n#seed|seeds} and p10–p90 band.
barrido.seriesNota: At each cycle, the mean over the seeds of each value; from the lightest color (lowest value) to the darkest (highest).
barrido.figSeries: {metrica}: mean series of each parameter value.
barrido.tablaNota: Last sample of each run, unmerged; sample standard deviation. Runs with a restarted round are not counted.
barrido.sinResultados: No run of the sweep has finished yet.
barrido.pie: Data embedded in this file: {series} final-value {series#curve|curves}, the per-value table and {n} finished {n#run|runs} (in the CSV, “corrida” is the parameter value of each mean series).
barrido.reescritos: {n#One of them writes|{n} of them write} {parametro} (or a parameter its sweep writes): {n#it is|they are} rewritten with each run’s value, so the sweep overrides only its own part and the other effects are kept.
barrido.sinReescritos: None of them writes the swept parameter.
barrido.sinCaliente: The source run had no live changes.
barrido.arrastra: Sweeping {parametro} also sets {otros} to the same value (the engine writes them together).
barrido.valorOrigenCambia: Value in the source run: {inicio} at the start and {fin} after its live changes.
barrido.figHasta: {metrica} at the end by {parametro}: mean of up to {n} {n#seed|seeds} per value and p10–p90 band.
barrido.reiniciosNota: These runs restarted the round (restart mode or a new F1 round) before the target cycle: their last sample is from a different cycle than the others, so they are left out of the curves, the series and the table.
